business.checked: Reference summaries consulted 2026-10-23. Cases, firms, amounts and ownership changes are fictional. US-specific tax, filing, membership limits and current Cameroonian legal capital minima are not imported. Authorised/issued/called/paid-up terms are explicit textbook models requiring local teacher confirmation. No actual nationalisation, privatisation, investment return or site recommendation is asserted.
